Know where you belong!
  
  
Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
  
  
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.
  
  
**The Team Or Role**
Match Group’s Analytics Team is looking for a Data Scientist II with expertise in Marketing Analytics.
  
  
Our analytics team serves the entire MG portfolio, acting as a center of excellence to standardize how we measure marketing performance across all our global brands, including industry leading names like Tinder and Hinge. We develop a deep understanding of the business and its data and establish close working relationships with all teams including Product, Marketing, Engineering, and Finance, so that we can provide recommendations and make proposals regarding prioritization of initiatives, marketing investments, A/B tests, and company performance.
  
  
As a data scientist in this role, you will partner with Marketing teams at each of our BUs, providing support through advanced marketing measurement techniques, A/B test design and analysis, and data-driven insights through ad-hoc analyses, presentations, and automated reports and dashboards. This role will require extensive experience with SQL, data wrangling, statistics, econometric modeling, and A/B testing, as well as the ability to work in cross-functional teams to drive actionable insights. Experience with user growth and acquisition across multi-brand consumer products is a plus.
  
  
**Where You’ll Work**
This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three days per week. This position is located in NYC or Los Angeles.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Master and be responsible for analyzing marketing and business performance.
* Build models better to understand the impact of our marketing investments and strategy
* Find the “story” in the data and communicate insights and opportunities with executives and other internal teams.
* Perform ongoing ad-hoc analyses to evaluate the efficiency of our marketing spend, build reporting infrastructure, and assist in making budgeting recommendations to optimize growth.
* Integrate captured event data with other customer data sources, such as surveys, ad publishers, and app store data.
* Support reporting and business intelligence needs of the entire Marketing team.

**You’ll Need**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in analytics or data science
* Experience building bayesian regressions and/or other marketing measurement techniques
* Experience designing, executing, and measuring geo experiments and causal inference techniques
* Ability to think objectively and interpret meaningful themes from quantitative and qualitative data
* Ability to build constructive and effective relationships with a broad and diverse group of business partners
* Ability to execute complex analytics projects where you have to determine salient questions in a complex ecosystem and present action-oriented conclusions
* Proficiency with SQL required
* Scripting skills, preferably in Python.
* Knowledge of statistics, specifically experimental design and analysis
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint (or equivalents)
* Familiarity with common marketing KPIs, metrics, and growth experiments

**Differentiators**

* Curiosity about how things work, from both a business and technical perspective, leading to the identification and exploration of new strategic opportunities, potential improvements to our data infrastructure, and deepening our understanding of member behavior.
* Proactive collaborator skilled in engaging with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Product, Engineering, Machine Learning) to influence decision-making, confidently voicing concerns and alternative perspectives
* Ability to prioritize time across multiple projects and communicate timelines

**Why Match Group?**
**Benefits**
Our mission is simple – to help people find love and happiness! We love our employees too and understand the importance of all life's milestones. Here are some of the benefits we are proud to offer:
  
  
***Mind & Body***
– Medical, mental health, and wellness benefits to support your overall health and well-being
  
  
***Financial Wellness***
– Competitive compensation, 100% employer match on 401k contributions up to 10% (cap at $10,000), as well as an employee stock purchase program to help you feel supported in your financial security
  
  
***Unplug***
– Generous PTO and 14 paid holidays so you can unplug
  
  
***Career***
– Annual training allowance for professional development and ERG membership opportunities and events so you feel connected and empowered in your work
  
  
***Family***
– Families come in all shapes and sizes so we offer 20 weeks of 100% paid parental leave, fertility, adoption, and child care resources, as well as pet insurance and discounts
  
  
***Company Gatherings***
– We host company events where our employees get to know each other and build a sense of connection and belonging!

**About The Company**
Turing is a San Francisco-based research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a partner to enterprises adopting advanced artificial intelligence. The company helps advance AI research through high-quality data, specialized training pipelines, and collaboration with experienced researchers across software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and AI agents. Turing also works with global organizations to move AI beyond proof of concept, developing systems designed to operate reliably, create measurable business impact, and support lasting improvements to business performance.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Engineering Evaluator, you will contribute to datasets and evaluation systems that train, benchmark, and improve large language models. You will work closely with researchers to develop code examples, produce accurate solutions, assess AI-generated code, and explain your judgments with clarity. The work focuses primarily on Python used in backend services, data pipelines, and machine learning infrastructure, with opportunities to evaluate code in JavaScript, including ReactJS, C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go.
  
  
You will examine engineering tasks across the software development lifecycle, from prototyping and architecture through API design, implementation, launch, experimentation, monitoring, and operational maintenance. You will also develop Python-based agents and automated verification tools to assess solution quality and identify recurring error patterns. This is a flexible contractor engagement for candidates based in the United States, with a commitment of at least 10 hours per week and up to 40 hours per week. The initial duration is one month, with potential extensions based on performance and fit. The application process takes approximately 15 to 30 minutes and includes a required AI video interview.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* At least three years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of building and maintaining production systems.
* Strong expertise in Python, including familiarity with its frameworks, development tools, testing practices, and production-ready engineering standards.
* Experience developing full-stack applications and deploying scalable software using modern languages, platforms, and tools.
* Solid understanding of software architecture, system design, implementation, debugging, and code quality assessment.
* Ability to evaluate code for correctness, efficiency, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and alignment with task requirements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide clear, structured rationales for technical judgments.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with researchers and cross-functional teams.
* Must be located in the United States and able to commit at least 10 hours per week.
* Experience at a high-scale technology organization or education in computer science can be valuable, but demonstrated skills and experience take precedence over institutional or employer pedigree.

**Responsibilities**

* Create and curate high-quality software engineering examples for AI training and benchmarking initiatives.
* Develop precise solutions and correct code, primarily in Python, while working with other supported programming languages as needed.
* Review AI-generated code and recommend improvements to its correctness, efficiency, scalability, and reliability.
* Build Python agents and automated verification mechanisms that test solutions and surface common error patterns.
* Assess AI capabilities across engineering workflows, including architecture decisions, API design, implementation, launch, and ongoing operations.
* Collaborate with researchers and cross-functional teams to strengthen AI coding systems and evaluate performance against relevant industry benchmarks.
* Document evaluation decisions in a consistent, rigorous, and understandable manner.

**Benefits**
This is a flexible contractor opportunity with a workload ranging from 10 to 40 hours per week and an initial one-month term, with possible extensions depending on performance and project needs. The role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to advanced AI research and enterprise coding solutions while applying production software engineering expertise to varied technical challenges. This contractor engagement does not include medical benefits or paid leave.
  
  
Equal Opportunity
  
  
Turing values contributions from people with varied professional, educational, and personal backgrounds. Candidates are considered based on relevant skills, experience, and ability to perform the work, rather than pedigree alone. The company is committed to fair and respectful consideration throughout the evaluation process.

**About The Company**
KLA develops technologies that help make the products and devices used in everyday life possible. Semiconductor manufacturing depends on the ability to inspect, measure, and analyze materials and processes with exceptional precision. KLA provides systems and software that help manufacturers identify defects, monitor process performance, and produce increasingly complex chips and other electronic components at scale.
  
  
The Semiconductor Products and Customers business unit designs, builds, and sells solutions supporting technologies such as artificial intelligence, data centers, automotive systems, and consumer electronics. Its portfolio serves logic and memory manufacturing, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment, and materials. Within this organization, the Film and Scatterometry Technology division develops metrology solutions for measuring film thickness, critical dimensions, composition, and resistivity. These technologies help customers advance semiconductor processes from early research and development through high-volume production.
  
  
**About The Role**
KLA is seeking a motivated Software Engineering Intern to contribute to the engineering team within the Film and Scatterometry Technology division. In this role, you will work with experienced engineers to develop, test, and improve software used in metrology systems and related engineering workflows. Your work will support tools that help semiconductor manufacturers understand process performance and maintain quality as device designs and production requirements evolve.
  
  
This internship offers practical experience applying software engineering principles to complex technical systems. You may contribute to software components, automation, data analysis, testing, or development utilities, depending on team priorities and your background. You will collaborate with colleagues across disciplines, learn how software interacts with hardware and measurement systems, and build familiarity with engineering practices used in a technology environment. The team will provide guidance as you take responsibility for well-defined tasks and deliver dependable, maintainable work.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience programming in at least one language, such as C++, C#, Python, Java, or a comparable language.
* Understanding of foundational software development concepts, including data structures, algorithms, debugging, and object-oriented design.
* Interest in developing software for technical applications, measurement systems, or scientific and engineering workflows.
* Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and collaborate respectfully with colleagues from different disciplines.
* Careful, analytical approach to problem solving, with a willingness to investigate issues and learn unfamiliar tools or concepts.
* Ability to manage assigned work, seek clarification when needed, and respond constructively to feedback.
* Coursework, projects, or experience involving software testing, data processing, version control, or hardware interaction is helpful.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop, update, and maintain software features or engineering tools under the direction of experienced team members.
* Write readable, organized code that follows established team conventions and supports future maintenance.
* Test software changes, document results, investigate defects, and help identify practical solutions.
* Use appropriate development tools and version control practices to support collaborative engineering work.
* Assist with analyzing measurement data, automating workflows, or improving software used alongside metrology systems.
* Participate in technical discussions and share progress, questions, and findings with the team.
* Prepare concise documentation describing software behavior, testing procedures, or implementation details.
* Follow engineering, quality, and information-handling practices relevant to assigned projects.
